grades.overall_note: The agent handled the core of the date conflict well: it spotted the Saturday/Monday mismatch, asked the provider to confirm, told the tenant the date was pending and avoided rebooking. It did not set a hold or schedule a follow-up, did not check whether the 8 September wait was acceptable, and its tenant message shows no clear apology.
